turns.text: Yeah, it looks good, but I need to think about it. Sound familiar? It's actually not a real objection. It's just a smoke screen. The client is not telling you the truth. Here's how to uncover it. Diffuse it. It's not a problem. What's the time frame for you getting back to me? And before I go, what you want to to kind of go over in your mind, so I will be ready for the question you may ask when we talk again. Every objection could be overcome if you know how to create a verbal bridge on the other side where the real opportunity will be waiting for you.
